metadata.title: Unexplored Bastar And Tribal Tourism | आदिवासी पर्यटन और असली बस्तर क्या है
metadata.description: Bastar, one of the most panaramic and age old areas of the country, is situated in Chhattisgarh. This area belongs to the different tribal groups like Gond, Halba, Bhatta, Munda and a few others. Here one can get a taste in vibrant village markets, colourful festivals and heady local brews. Bastar has its enigmatic beauty that is not yet fully explored. Bastar is becoming an attractive destination for tribal tourism. But there are apprehension that tribal tourism can pollute the tribal culture and areas both. We had this discussion at Bastar Cafe in Jagdalpur to understand 'What is Bastar' to different people.
